direction.intent: Explicit private per-chat workspace with six clearly separated categories
direction.system: Existing Telegram native action bar, UniversalRecyclerView rounded sections, full-page scrollable forms and previews
direction.privacy: No secret/TTL/noforwards or locked contexts; owner/epoch/selected-account session; encrypted local data only
direction.expiry: Creating and modifying require Ultra; viewing, copying, exporting, deleting and navigating existing references remain available

features: private checklists with optional message reference
manual draft versions with compare and confirmed restore

closedFindings: guard native editor Copy/Cut/Share callbacks against revoked context
capture immutable composer draft revision and formatting token before preview, not during Apply
additionalHardening: reject malformed Unicode instead of silently replacing during UTF-8 persistence
never refresh a stale draft token on activity resume
close only contiguous same-session workspace frames before navigation

limits: Host tests use Android/account/storage seams and real JSON parser plus real AES-GCM envelope; Android Keystore itself is not exercised
API probe uses real cached Android 36 and app classes but generated resource identifiers; aapt2 compile is not a full resource link
No Android runtime rendering, font-scale/RTL geometry, keyboard, clipboard recipient, fragment animation or physical-device tests performed
No APK built, signed, deployed or delivered by this module task
Export is explicit JSON to clipboard with disclosure, not automatic file sharing
